description: Install PAN for Codex locally and confirm, without a model, that the prompt Codex builds for this project carries PAN's AGENTS.md section with its routing table, next to the project's own notes.
why: Project memory routing (ADR-0050): the routing table only helps if the host puts it in front of the model. `codex debug prompt-input` renders the model-visible prompt input without sending it, so no login and no model; first measured on Codex CLI 0.163.0 (2026-10-31). Every codex step runs with CODEX_HOME at a scratch home under <other>, so the user's ~/.codex is never read or written. SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent.

steps.why: Codex refuses a CODEX_HOME that does not exist yet, so the scratch home is created first. The script refuses the real home and its dot-directories.

expect: stdout~### When to use PAN in this project
steps.why: The installer's contract: PAN's section, in the default advisory mode, is on disk.

steps.why: The measurement: Codex read the project's AGENTS.md into the prompt it would send, table included. A section Codex cut for its byte budget, or a file it did not find, fails here.
